support_request.addressee: EGID Market Data / Feed API / Technical Support
support_request.subject: Feed API — GetSymbolHistories / GetToken Technical Contract Request
support_request.body:
We are integrating an internal read-only market-data validation workflow for Egyptian Exchange historical daily data. Integration is currently blocked only on the exact executable API contract; no live trading or order-entry capability is required.

We have identified the following operations in the EGID Feed API:
• GET /api/DelayedFeed/GetSymbolHistories
• GET /api/Feed/GetSymbolHistories
• POST /api/Settings/GetToken

Please provide the exact executable contract for retrieving historical daily OHLCV for an EGX-listed equity, covering the following:

A. Historical request contract
1) Please confirm the exact HTTP method and endpoint path for each GetSymbolHistories operation.
2) Are input parameters query, body, or route parameters?
3) Please provide the complete required and optional parameter list, exact names, data types, and example values.
4) Which security identifier is accepted (ticker, security code, instrument ID, ISIN, or another identifier)? Please provide one normal EGX-equity example.
5) Is a market/exchange code required? If yes, what exact value represents the Egyptian Exchange?
6) Please provide the start-date and end-date parameter names, exact date format, and whether the requested range is inclusive.
7) Please provide the interval/granularity parameter and exact value required for one daily bar.
8) Please provide pagination, result-limit, ordering, and maximum historical-window rules.

B. Authentication contract — POST /api/Settings/GetToken
1) Please provide the exact request-body schema, required fields, and Content-Type.
2) Please provide a dummy request and dummy response.
3) Which response field contains the access token, what is the token type, lifetime, and refresh mechanism?
4) Can the same token be reused across historical requests?
5) How exactly must the token be supplied to Feed/DelayedFeed requests: Authorization: Bearer, custom header, API key, cookie, query parameter, or another mechanism?
6) Can a long-lived token safely be stored as an application/repository secret, or must token acquisition occur dynamically because of expiry/refresh requirements?

C. GetSymbolHistories response schema
Please provide the response JSON schema, or one redacted sample response, identifying the exact fields for: security symbol, security ID, ISIN if available, trade/session date, timestamp, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Turnover, Value Traded, Trade Count, market/exchange, interval/granularity, and any final/closed status. Please also explain any wrapper or nested objects.

D. Volume semantics
Does the historical daily Volume field represent the exact raw number of shares traded during that EGX trading session? Please identify the exact field name for raw traded-share session volume and confirm that it is not monetary turnover, value traded, average daily volume, split-adjusted synthetic volume, rounded display volume, or partial/current-session cumulative volume.

E. Finalized EOD semantics
Please confirm how a client can determine that a historical daily row represents a completed/finalized EGX trading session. Are historical daily bars finalized automatically after session close? Is there a final/closed flag? Can a daily row be intraday/partial before close? Does DelayedFeed alter finalization semantics? Can completed previous-session rows later be revised?

F. DelayedFeed versus Feed
Is GET /api/DelayedFeed/GetSymbolHistories sufficient for retrieving final historical daily OHLCV for a completed session? If yes, does finalized historical data differ from GET /api/Feed/GetSymbolHistories after session finalization? If no, which Feed entitlement/API is required?

G. Historical entitlement
Which EGID Feed API package/license enables historical EGX OHLCV? Does GetSymbolHistories require a separate entitlement? Is delayed historical access available? Is historical daily raw share Volume included? What is the retention depth, and is data for 2026-09-17 available?

H. Validation example
If permitted, please provide one sample request/response for ticker EHDR for session 2026-09-17. If entitlement rules prevent that, a sample for any normal EGX-listed equity using the same historical daily schema is sufficient.

Our integration requires only HTTPS historical retrieval returning JSON with reliable security identity, one exact completed daily session, exact numeric Open/High/Low/Close, and exact integer traded-share Volume.

Thank you for providing the endpoint contract and entitlement details needed to complete this read-only integration.
